subject: [PATCH fstests] btrfs: test graceful ENOMEM handling in synchronous dirops

reviews.author: Filipe Manana
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that leaving the commit ID as a placeholder (xxxxxxxxxxxx) may not be sufficient for testing purposes, as it can lead to issues when updating the commit ID later.
reviews.raw_body:
No, we just leave the commit ID as xxxxxxxxxxxx and update it later
once the patch is in Linus' tree.

Thanks.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to fstests for Btrfs to verify that it handles ENOMEM errors during synchronous directory operations in a graceful manner.
